label: 4-channel CWDM mux/demux, LC/UPC, FMU plug-in
description: 4-channel dual-fibre CWDM mux/demux on the ITU-T G.694.2 20 nm grid, covering 1510/1530/1550/1570 nm, with a duplex LC/UPC line port and one duplex LC/UPC port per channel. Passive thin-film-filter module: insertion loss <=2.2 dB across the passband, adjacent-channel isolation >=30 dB, return loss >=45 dB, no power or software.
